stem_bark.text: The bark of Colubrina asiatica is greyish-coloured, longitudinally fissured and transversally cracked.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Colubrina asiatica is greyish-coloured, longitudinally fissured and transversally cracked.

leaf.text: The leaves of Colubrina asiatica grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is chartaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaves have a curved and 2-2.5 cm long petiole . The leaf of Colubrina asiatica is 7-15 cm long and 3-5 cm wide. The shape of the blade is ovate, the apex is acuminate, the base is rounded and the margins are crenate. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.
leaf.text_html:
The leaves of Colubrina asiatica grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged).
The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is chartaceous and glabrous on both sides.
The leaves have a curved and 2-2.5 cm long petiole.
The leaf of Colubrina asiatica is 7-15 cm long and 3-5 cm wide. The shape of the blade is ovate, the apex is acuminate, the base is rounded and the margins are crenate.
The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Colubrina asiatica is a thornless, climbing and evergreen shrub growing up to 4-5 m high.
habit.text_html: Colubrina asiatica is a thornless, climbing and evergreen shrub growing up to 4-5 m high.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Colubrina asiatica is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Colubrina asiatica is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Colubrina asiatica are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Colubrina asiatica is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Colubrina asiatica is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Colubrina asiatica are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.

handicrafts.text: As its common name (lather leaf) implies, the leaves of Colubrina asiatica , when crushed, possess lathering properties and are used as a detergent and shampoo.

reforestation.text: Colubrina asiatica can be planted in the sun or half shade. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining. The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings. 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Colubrina asiatica can be planted in the sun or half shade. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining.
    The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings.

  • Seed treatments :

    24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
